intent_contract.text: The first approved alternative: a non-sensual Gothic fallen-angel maid portrait that retains the attached adult portrait as the face and hair reference.

A photorealistic Gothic fashion portrait of an unmistakably adult woman, with the attached portrait as the sole facial and hair reference, appearing as a solemn fallen-angel maid. She stands in a candlelit manor library and carefully pours tea from a tarnished silver pot into a black porcelain cup. Her formal floor-length black satin maid dress has a high lace collar, fitted long sleeves, a structured waist, ivory cuffs, a layered ankle-length skirt, and a crisp lace headpiece, creating dignified Gothic fashion. Broad charcoal wings fold behind her, a fractured dark halo floats above, and loose feathers rest across the polished floor. Preserve her warm brown almond-shaped eyes, soft oval face, adult facial proportions, natural skin texture, and long glossy wavy black hair. Her expression is calm and self-possessed. Cool moonlight from a tall arched window meets amber candlelight along the feathers and satin. Full-body vertical composition, 50mm lens, realistic fabric and feather texture, restrained color, shallow depth of field.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.

render_gates.description: The subject and any relationship counterpart are unmistakably adult fictional people, while the requested identity, role, and styling remain intact.
A calm low-expression baseline remains immediately legible without becoming hostile, frightened, vacant, or broadly cheerful.
The quiet support action and localized warmth clearly point to one identifiable trusted adult counterpart rather than everyone in the scene.
One practical target-directed act is concretely readable and is not replaced by an adjective, gaze, costume, role, or caring prop alone.
Exactly one restrained facial, hand, or shoulder region softens toward the trusted counterpart while the rest of the composed baseline remains stable.
An already-visible helpful consequence belongs to the same counterpart, such as relief, restored comfort, or resumed activity.
Stable composure, selective warmth, practical support, and its same-target consequence coexist in one still without an abrupt personality reversal.
Hair, eyes, costume, gender, role, posture, and muted or cool styling remain optional; none is accepted as archetype proof without the relationship behavior.

obligation.composition_instruction: Make the drink's stability physically readable: the near-upright cup has broad visible base contact and slight fabric compression on a fully covered upper-torso support surface, its center of mass stays inside that support, and both hands remain clearly separated.

render_gates.description: The cup is near upright rather than visibly tipping or falling.
The full cup base visibly contacts a broad opaque-clothed support area with a shallow contact shadow or compression.
The cup centerline falls inside the visible support area, so the load appears stable.
Both hands are visibly separated from the cup and do not secretly hold or brace it.
No straw bite, chin contact, transparent shelf, cropped hand, or concealed prop supplies the missing support.
